log.text: Light Screen up on P1's side
Tsareena used High Jump Kick → Grimmsnarl
Light Screen ended on P1's side

decisions.rationale: Lead Grimm+Altaria vs Whims+Delphox: Prankster FO/screens + Cloud Nine denies rain/TW value; Ape+Gengar back for Defiant wincon and safe Shadow Tag later. Avoid Gengar lead into Psychic.

Lead Mega Delphox + Tsareena to pressure Mega Gengar immediately while Queenly Majesty blocks Grimmsnarl’s Fake Out. Metagross provides Psychic Fangs to remove screens and strong coverage; Whimsicott adds flexible Tailwind, Light Screen, and Encore support without rain weakening Delphox.
decisions.notebook: Mega Delphox outspeeds maximum-Speed Mega Gengar and unscreened Psychic guarantees the OHKO. Opponent favors Mega Gengar + Grimmsnarl, with dual screens and defensive Annihilape Protects; Altaria can provide Cloud Nine and Tailwind. Against this structure, lead Mega Delphox + Tsareena, retain Metagross for Psychic Fangs, and use strong single hits rather than Triple Axel into Annihilape. Tsareena’s Queenly Majesty blocks opposing targeted priority while active; Wide Lens makes its 90%-accurate moves 99% accurate. Whimsicott is the preferred flexible fourth for Tailwind, Light Screen, and Encore; reassess if Primarina or Avalugg becomes central.

decisions.rationale: Queenly blocks FO on both foes. Prankster Reflect (+1) before Tsareena physicals; Light Clay extends. Altaria Tailwind outspeeds Delphox next and enables offense. Cloud Nine already up. Avoid FO/ally targets and unsafe switches into DGleam/TA.
Bring Annihilape behind Reflect; Gengar is Psychic-weak to Delphox and should not enter now. Ape pressures both, sets up Defiant later, and respects Queenly. Screens already up.

Mega Dazzling Gleam pressures both Fairy-weak foes while Triple Axel exploits Altaria’s 4x Ice weakness. Queenly Majesty blocks Fake Out, and concentrating Tsareena’s strongest matchup into Altaria offers the best chance to remove Tailwind/Will-O-Wisp support despite a possible screen.
decisions.notebook: Mega Delphox reaches 204 Speed and 211 Special Attack with the current spread, outspeeding maximum-Speed Mega Gengar; unscreened Psychic guarantees the OHKO. Opponent favors Mega Gengar + Grimmsnarl with dual screens and defensive Annihilape Protects; Altaria supplies Cloud Nine, Tailwind, and Will-O-Wisp. Preserve Metagross for Psychic Fangs against screens. Prefer strong single hits over Triple Axel into Annihilape. Tsareena’s Queenly Majesty blocks opposing priority targeting either ally while Tsareena is active. Wide Lens makes each Triple Axel accuracy check 99%, about 97% for all three hits. Whimsicott remains the preferred flexible fourth for Tailwind, Light Screen, and Encore; reassess if Primarina or Avalugg becomes central.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Annihilape)
decisions.rationale: Prankster Light Screen before Delphox specials; Reflect already up with Clay. Ape Protects through Psychic/DGleam and Tsareena hits while screens finish stacking. No FO/priority into Queenly. Avoid Gengar vs Delphox.
decisions.notebook: Opp: rain Politoed Drizzle+ShedShell; Basculegion SwiftSwim MysticWater Jolly WaveCrash/LastRespects/AquaJet/Protect; Mega Delphox Timid Psychic/HeatWave/DGleam/Protect (megas immediately); Metagross LO Adamant MeteorMash/PsychicFangs/IcePunch/Protect; Whimsicott MentalHerb Prankster Timid Tailwind/Encore/LS/Moonblast; Tsareena WideLens Queenly Adamant PowerWhip/TripleAxel/HJK/Protect. Leads Whims+Delphox, Tsareena switch-in punishes FO/priority. Our core: CloudNine Altaria; Mega Gengar ShadowTag (Psychic-frail—avoid leading/mega vs Delphox); Grimmsnarl LC screens+FO+SpiritBreak; Annihilape Defiant RF wincon. Priority: deny Tailwind/rain, respect Queenly (no FO/prio into open Tsareena), stack screens before Ape, tag Delphox/Metagross only on safe entry.

decisions.rationale: Psychic applies maximum pressure to Annihilape before it can move and OHKOs if Light Screen is not established. Power Whip is Tsareena’s strongest accurate-enough hit into Grimmsnarl; unlike High Jump Kick, it gains STAB and avoids crash risk. The split attack also punishes Annihilape Protect while retaining Queenly Majesty.

decisions.rationale: Screens up; Grimm 6% dies to any hit and moves last—sac him. RF Delphox for SE 47-89% chip. SB Delphox for SpA drop if he lives to act. Ape tanks under LS+Reflect. No Protect (50% fail). No Gengar into Psychic.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Protect preserves Delphox from the likely Rage Fist while Tsareena removes 6% Grimmsnarl with a 99%-accurate High Jump Kick. Queenly Majesty blocks Fake Out, so Grimmsnarl cannot disrupt the knockout. This clears the screen setter without powering up Rage Fist and retains Delphox to pressure Annihilape or the incoming backline.

Gengar fainted: pass. Metagross at 47% dies to Rage Fist (Ghost 2x, prior hits boost power); Tsareena Queenly blocks prio and resists Fighting. KO Metagross now before it can Psychic Fangs or Mash Ape.

Annihilape is guaranteed faster and can KO Metagross before Psychic Fangs. Protect Metagross against the obvious Rage Fist while Tsareena lands its strongest accurate neutral hit; this preserves the only attack that can immediately KO Annihilape and creates a follow-up double-target threat.

decisions.rationale: Last mon at 44%. Meta LO Mash/Fangs and Tsareena Whip all OHKO; Ape outspeeds only Meta. RF (X=1→100BP) KOs Meta ~65-108% but Tsareena still KOs same turn → lose game. Protect is mandatory; successive Meta Protect is 1/3. Survive to stack hits/Leftovers.

Double-target Annihilape. It moves first and can remove Metagross, but Tsareena survives to finish it with Power Whip; if it attacks Tsareena instead, Psychic Fangs provides the stronger backup KO. Repeating Protect is unreliable, while High Jump Kick is immune.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Sole Ape 50% vs both; prior PW did ~62% so any hit KOes. Protect (even reduced) is only path to possibly live + Leftovers, then punch back. Attacking loses to double target. Gengar fainted=pass.

Protect Metagross from the likely boosted Rage Fist while Tsareena’s Power Whip threatens the knockout. This preserves a second attacker if Power Whip misses; Annihilape’s consecutive Protect also has reduced success odds.

decisions.rationale: RF now BP100 (1 prior hit) KOes 47% Meta from full range and Ape outspeeds it always. Meta Protect fail-prone after use; snipe the LO threat first. Tsareena PW may KO back but leaves 1v1. No Protect (streak fail risk). CC/DP worse dmg/no SE.

Double-target Annihilape. It moves first, but can remove only one partner; the survivor threatens a KO. Power Whip has already shown enough damage to finish it, while Psychic Fangs is super effective. A third consecutive Protect has a very low success rate, so attacking with both maximizes the win chance.

reflections.summary: Lost because team-preview brought and immediately Mega-evolved Psychic-frail Gengar into known Mega Delphox + Metagross; after the Whimsicott trade Delphox forced the Gengar KO, Psychic Fangs stripped screens, and Annihilape was isolated to die to Tsareena Power Whip.
reflections.adjustment: Change preview: bench Mega Gengar (or never Mega it while Delphox remains) and bring a safer Delphox/Metagross answer so screens + Ape are not stranded.
reflections.notebook: Opp: rain Politoed Drizzle+ShedShell; Basculegion SwiftSwim MysticWater Jolly WaveCrash/LastRespects/AquaJet/Protect; Mega Delphox Timid Psychic/HeatWave/DGleam/Protect (megas immediately); Metagross LO Adamant MeteorMash/PsychicFangs/IcePunch/Protect; Whimsicott MentalHerb Prankster Timid Tailwind/Encore/LS/Moonblast; Tsareena WideLens Queenly Adamant PowerWhip/TripleAxel/HJK/Protect. Can drop rain entirely for Whims+MegaDelphox+Metagross+Tsareena and still close. Psychic Fangs reliably strips screens; Tsareena spams Power Whip under Wide Lens. Our core: CloudNine Altaria; Mega Gengar ShadowTag (Psychic-frail—do not bring/mega while Delphox available); Grimmsnarl LC screens+FO+SpiritBreak; Annihilape Defiant RF wincon. Priority: deny Tailwind/rain, respect Queenly (no FO/prio into open Tsareena), stack screens before Ape only with safe partners, never tag Delphox/Metagross on Gengar entry. Next preview must keep Gengar benched or unmega’d vs this core.

reflections.summary: Won because Mega Delphox’s Speed pressured Mega Gengar, Metagross removed the dual screens, and Tsareena’s strong single-target Power Whip broke through Annihilape’s Protect stalling. The four and Delphoxite were well suited overall, although screened Psychic only left Gengar at 1% and forced a Delphox trade.
reflections.adjustment: Keep Mega Delphox, Tsareena, and Metagross, but prioritize Psychic Fangs screen removal before committing Delphox’s Psychic into Gengar; this should secure the unscreened OHKO and preserve Delphox. Whimsicott remains the flexible fourth unless Primarina or Avalugg is shown.
reflections.notebook: Mega Delphox outspeeds Mega Gengar and guarantees the Psychic OHKO only without Light Screen; through Light Screen, Gengar can survive at about 1%. Opponent favors Mega Gengar behind Grimmsnarl dual screens and uses Annihilape to stall focused attacks with repeated Protect before firing boosted Rage Fist. Preserve Metagross for timely Psychic Fangs screen removal, ideally before Delphox attacks. Tsareena’s Power Whip deals more than half to Annihilape and is the preferred finishing attack; exploit reduced consecutive Protect odds by continuing double targets when either attacker can finish. Retain Delphoxite and the Tsareena/Metagross core for this matchup; Whimsicott is the adjustable fourth.
